entities.name: Dichlorofluoroaniline
observations: Expected product is Nc1cc(Cl)c(F)c(Cl)c1, formed by reducing the aromatic nitro group to an aniline.
The aryl chlorine and fluorine substituents remain unchanged in the matched reaction record.

entities.name: Aryl nitro reduction
observations: Zinc under protic ammonium/methanol/water conditions reduces Ar-NO2 to Ar-NH2 in the matched reaction.
